# FG-DB-0010

| 項目 | 値 |
|---|---|
| HTTP ステータス | 500 |
| 重大度 | warn |
| Runbook | なし |
| 発生させるテスト | `a_change_with_too_many_events_is_rejected_before_writing` |

## 利用者向けメッセージ

- ja: 変更を保存できませんでした。管理者に連絡してください。
- en: The change could not be saved. Contact the administrator.
- id: Perubahan tidak dapat disimpan. Hubungi administrator.

## 原因 (cause)

A typed command built a change that forge refuses before it reaches the database (ADR-0016 §6): more than 100 events in one change record, an event type that is not a lowercase dotted name, an event from an anonymous actor (events always name who acted), or an audit or event field outside its bounds. This is a bug in the command that built it.

## 調べ方 (diagnosis)

The event carries `reason` (too_many_events with `count`, invalid_event_type, anonymous_event, field_too_long with `field`) and `action` (the audit action of the change). Nothing was written: the transaction was rolled back.

## 対処 (fix)

Fix the command named by `action`: emit one aggregate event instead of many, use a registered event type, or give the change a non-anonymous actor.
